momentum_dependent_cubic_positive_contro.scope: A standalone oscillator illustrating coordinate-induced vertices; not the non-invariant compact Einstein profile.

core_scaling.scope: Full output of fixed occupation inputs; neither an operator-norm limit on the whole block nor a joint volume limit.

creation_scaling.scope: Exact p-cell raising interactions exhibit the sharp quadratic, cubic and quartic powers. The general fixed-order theorem is analytical.

odd_micro_spectra.scope: An internal-rotation-invariant scalar parity-breaking example preserves selection; its vertex is not asserted to be the Einstein tensor vertex.

odd_radial_convergence.scope: Every O(5) angular sector is checked at each R; the ground-state convergence theorem remains at fixed volume and positive regulator.

cubic_lift.scope: An exact noncommuting cubic monomial tests the general Weyl lift used for every monomial of the Einstein cubic density.

einstein_cubic_density.scope: Local integrated-curvature cubic density in a traceless frame; finite jets do not impose or solve the full gravitational constraints.

higher_order_chart.scope: A diagonal three-cell guard preserves the previous sector-selection proof and avoids a guard quartic at order 1/R. It does not establish selection after adding the Einstein cubic.

matching_relation.G_match: sigma^2 a^2/(32 pi R) = s^2 sqrt(U/g) a^2/(32 pi R)
matching_relation.assumptions: v=sqrt(Ug), b=(U/g)^(1/4), H_phys=H_lat/(a v), Qhat=Q/b=a phi, h=s Q/sqrt(R), sigma=s b, and the supplied Einstein normalization.
matching_relation.not_established: An actual Newton coupling, area entropy law, coarse-graining map or selected gravitational phase.

scope: Regular finite-order collective interactions have cubic and quartic coefficients of order R^-1/2 and R^-1. A parity-breaking two-cell example preserves vacuum selection yet has the same fixed-volume Gaussian limit. The supplied Einstein cubic has an exact bounded-strength three-cell Weyl lift; a higher-order guard avoids fixing a leading quartic. Selection and physical constraints for that lift are unproved. Point cotangent maps cannot supply its pure potential cubic. A conditional G matching relation motivates coordinated coarse scaling; it is not a physical G derivation or TOE.
